March, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:21973
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 59 of 2024
Applicant :- Gaya Prasad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Firoz Ahmad Khan,Toshendra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.192 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B,
302/34 Ipc & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S.-Karnailganj, District-Gonda.
3.  It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the mother-in-law of the deceased was enlarged on bail by order dated 20.02.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.13645 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.13645 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant, who is the father-in-law of the deceased having no criminal history, hence, he may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the submissions made at the bar, adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 20.02.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.13645 of 2023, the applicant, is also entitled to be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.13645 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: As such, the applicant is enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant- Gaya Prasad be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
.
[Pankaj Bhatia,J.] Order Date :- 12.3.2024 -Amit K-
